SEARCH
Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockBlocks

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockBlocks
public final class BedrockBlocks extends Object
Every block type of Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release. The constants are resolved against the newest data of Paletter.bundled() on first use; referencing them loads nothing.

Constants are added when Bedrock adds blocks (binary compatible). Blocks Bedrock removes stay, deprecated, and resolve to their fallback; renamed blocks keep their old constant, deprecated, as an alias of the new one.

The @since of a constant is the bundled Bedrock release it first appears in, without an experiment toggle (decided from the BDS captures in data/bds); 26.40 is the oldest bundled release, so it may be older. @Education marks content BDS only offers to worlds with Education Edition features, which isEducation() of the type answers at runtime.

Since:
1.0.0
